screen.title: Conversation: Booking a practice room
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between a student and a music department assistant.

audio.text: Excuse me, are any practice rooms free? I've got a piano exam on Monday.
Not right now, I'm afraid. They're booked until eight. But you can reserve one for tomorrow morning on the department website.
I tried that, but it said I need a music student account.
Ah, students from other departments have to book in person. I can put your name down for nine tomorrow, if you like.

questions.stem: Why does the man talk to the woman?
options: He needs a place to prepare for an exam.
He wants to sign up for piano lessons.
He wants to open a music student account.
He hopes to move his exam to another day.

why.en: Purpose (paraphrase): a practice room before his piano exam. C borrows "account".
why.tr: Amaç (parafraz): sınav öncesi çalışma odası. C "account" kelimesini ödünç alıyor.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the man?
options: He already has a room booked for tonight.
He is not a student in the music department.
He prefers to practice in the evening.
He has an account on the department website.

why.en: Inference: the website needs a music student account and "students from other departments" book in person. D contradicts the conversation.
why.tr: Çıkarım: site müzik öğrencisi hesabı istiyor ve "başka bölüm öğrencileri" yüz yüze rezervasyon yapıyor. D konuşmayla çelişiyor.
